svg.title: Inference: the workshop
svg.desc: Schematic, in progress. A terracotta-roofed workshop with open shelves, the cache. Workers carrying blocks queue at its door: requests. Three go in together as a batch and a fourth slips in mid-way as a slot frees. Shelves fill with small blocks as each request works and empty when it finishes. Paper planes fly out of the window to three mailboxes: tokens streaming out. Numbered signposts: queue, batch, cache, tokens.
